 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. As the second round of the DFB-Pokal rolls into the picture, German second division side VfL Bochum welcome Bundesliga outfit Mainz 05 to the Ruhrstadion this evening.
 With kick-off scheduled for 18:00 CET in just under an hour's time, you can find the confirmed starting lineups for both teams below.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Confirmed VfL Bochum vs. Mainz 05 lineups:
 VfL Bochum (4-2-3-1): Horn – Klaiber, Steinwinder, Mets, Wittek – Meyer, Pannewig – Holtmann, Taz, Rasmussen – Steuckers
 Mainz 05 (3-3-2-2): Schwolow – Da Costa, Posch, Potulski – Widmer, Sano, Mwene – Nebel, Lee – Tietz, Becker
